    when: is_review_mode == true
    actions:
      - action: set
        target: headless_mode
        value: true
  - kind: technique
    id: ingest-prior-feedback
    technique: review-existing-feedback
    when: is_review_mode == true
  - kind: technique
    id: derive-host-repo
    technique: git::resolve-host-repo
  - kind: technique
    id: resolve-repo-root
    technique: repo-root-resolution
  - kind: technique
    id: read-reviewed-pr-body
    technique:
      name: github::view-pr
      inputs:
        repo_path: component_git_dir
    when: is_review_mode == true
  - kind: technique
    id: verify-reviewed-pr-body
    technique:
      name: update-pr::verify-body
      inputs:
        rendered_pr_body: pr_body
    when: is_review_mode == true
  - kind: technique
    id: update-repo-submodules
    technique: manage-git::update-repo-submodules
    condition:
      type: simple
      variable: host_repo_path
      operator: exists
  - kind: action
    id: verify-signing-precondition
    actions:
      - action: validate
        target: signing.configured == true
        message: Commit signing is not configured for this repository (user.signingkey, commit.gpgsign, or a working signing backend is missing).
  - kind: routine
    id: analyze-repo-with-gitnexus
    routine: ensure-graph-index
    with:
      repo_path: "{component_git_dir}"
    outputs:
      gitnexus_indexed: gitnexus_indexed
  - kind: technique
    id: detect-merge-strategy
    technique: manage-git::detect-merge-strategy
  - kind: technique
    id: detect-project-type
    technique: project-type-detection
  - kind: action
    id: announce-project-type
    actions:
      - action: message
        message: "Project type: {project_type}."
  - kind: technique
    id: check-issue
    technique: issue-reference-detection
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: issue-verification
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_present
          operator: ==
          value: false
    message: No GitHub or Jira issue is associated with this work package.
    options:
      - id: provide-existing
        label: Provide existing issue
        description: "Share the issue number or URL (GitHub #N or Jira PROJ-N)"
        effect:
          setVariable:
            needs_issue_creation: false
      - id: create-issue
        label: Create new issue
        description: Create a new issue in GitHub or Jira
        effect:
          setVariable:
            needs_issue_creation: true
      - id: skip-issue
        label: Skip issue
        description: Proceed without (not recommended for non-trivial work)
        effect:
          setVariable:
            issue_skipped: true
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: platform-selection
    condition:
      type: simple
      variable: needs_issue_creation
      operator: ==
      value: true
    message: The new issue needs a tracker to live in.
    options:
      - id: github
        label: GitHub
        description: Create issue in GitHub repository
        effect:
          setVariable:
            issue_platform: github
      - id: jira
        label: Jira
        description: Create issue in Jira project
        effect:
          setVariable:
            issue_platform: jira
  - kind: technique
    id: detect-provided-issue-reference
    technique: issue-reference-detection
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_present
          operator: ==
          value: false
        - type: simple
          variable: needs_issue_creation
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_skipped
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_platform
          operator: notExists
  - kind: technique
    id: verify-jira-issue
    technique:
      name: atlassian::get-jira-issue
      inputs:
        issueIdOrKey: "{issue_number}"
    when: issue_platform == 'jira'
    actions:
      - action: validate
        target: cloudId != null
        message: Atlassian cloudId is not resolved, so no Jira operation can run. Resolve the cloudId for the site and re-run.
  - kind: technique
    id: verify-github-issue
    technique:
      name: github::view-issue
      inputs:
        repo_path: component_git_dir
    when: issue_platform == 'github'
  - kind: technique
    id: search-github-issue
    technique:
      name: github::list-issues
      inputs:
        repo_path: component_git_dir
        search_text: "{jira_issue_key}"
    when: issue_platform == 'jira'
    actions:
      - action: set
        target: github_issue_found
        description: true if a GitHub issue referencing jira_issue_key was found, false otherwise
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: github-issue-missing
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_platform
          operator: ==
          value: jira
        - type: simple
          variable: github_issue_found
          operator: ==
          value: false
    message: No GitHub issue mirrors Jira ticket {jira_issue_key}, so the pull request has nothing to trace to in the target repo.
    defaultOption: create
    autoAdvanceMs: 30000
    options:
      - id: create
        label: Create GitHub issue
        description: Create a GitHub issue in the target repo mirroring the Jira ticket
        effect:
          setVariable:
            needs_github_issue_creation: true
      - id: skip
        label: Skip — use Jira ticket only
        description: Proceed without a GitHub issue
        effect:
          setVariable:
            needs_github_issue_creation: false
  - kind: technique
    id: create-github-issue-for-jira
    technique:
      name: create-issue::create-github
    when: needs_github_issue_creation == true
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: jira-project-selection
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_platform
          operator: ==
          value: jira
        - type: simple
          variable: needs_issue_creation
          operator: ==
          value: true
    message: The new Jira issue needs a project to live in.
    options:
      - id: select
        label: Select from list
        description: Choose from available projects
        effect:
          setVariable:
            jira_project: selected
      - id: specify
        label: Specify project key
        description: Provide a specific project key
        effect:
          setVariable:
            jira_project: specified
  - kind: technique
    id: derive-issue-type
    technique: issue-type-detection
    when: is_review_mode != true && needs_issue_creation != true && issue_skipped != true
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: issue-type-selection
    condition:
      type: or
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: needs_issue_creation
          operator: ==
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_type_ambiguous
          operator: ==
          value: true
    message: The drafted issue's type is unsettled.
    options:
      - id: feature
        label: Feature / Story
        description: User-facing capability with clear value
        effect:
          setVariable:
            issue_type: feature
            issue_type_ambiguous: false
      - id: bug
        label: Bug
        description: Defect in existing functionality
        effect:
          setVariable:
            issue_type: bug
            issue_type_ambiguous: false
      - id: task
        label: Task
        description: Technical work not directly user-facing
        effect:
          setVariable:
            issue_type: task
            issue_type_ambiguous: false
      - id: enhancement
        label: Enhancement
        description: Improvement to existing functionality
        effect:
          setVariable:
            issue_type: enhancement
            issue_type_ambiguous: false
      - id: epic
        label: Epic (Jira only)
        description: Large feature spanning multiple stories/tasks
        effect:
          setVariable:
            issue_type: epic
            issue_type_ambiguous: false
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: issue-review
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: needs_issue_creation
          operator: ==
          value: true
    message: The drafted issue stands ready as written.
    options:
      - id: create
        label: Create issue
      - id: edit
        label: Edit issue
        description: Make changes before creating
      - id: cancel
        label: Cancel issue creation
        description: Do not create the issue
        effect:
          setVariable:
            issue_cancelled: true
  - kind: technique
    id: create-github-issue
    technique: create-issue::create-github
    when: needs_issue_creation == true && issue_platform == 'github'
  - kind: technique
    id: create-jira-issue
    technique: create-issue::create-jira
    when: needs_issue_creation == true && issue_platform == 'jira'
  - kind: technique
    id: lookup-current-user
    technique: atlassian::user-info
    when: issue_platform == 'jira' && issue_skipped != true
  - kind: technique
    id: assign-issue-jira
    technique:
      name: atlassian::edit-jira-issue
      inputs:
        issueIdOrKey: "{issue_number}"
        fields: "{ assignee: { accountId: {accountId} } }"
    when: issue_skipped != true && issue_platform == 'jira'
  - kind: technique
    id: transition-issue-jira
    technique:
      name: atlassian::transition-jira-issue
      inputs:
        issueIdOrKey: "{issue_number}"
    when: issue_skipped != true && issue_platform == 'jira'
  - kind: technique
    id: assign-issue-github
    technique:
      name: github::assign-issue
      inputs:
        repo_path: component_git_dir
        assignee: "@me"
    when: issue_skipped != true && issue_platform == 'github'
  - kind: technique
    id: initialize-planning-folder
    technique:
      name: workflow-engine::create-readme
      inputs:
        seed_profile: work-package/readme-seed
        is_review_mode: "{is_review_mode}"
  - kind: technique
    id: present-problem-overview
    technique:
      name: stakeholder-overview
      inputs:
        readme_section_heading: "## Problem Overview"
        source_material: "{issue_record}"
    actions:
      - action: message
        message: |-
          [Problem Overview]({planning_folder_path}/README.md#problem-overview) — plain-language summary for stakeholder reference

          {stakeholder_overview}
  - kind: technique
    id: derive-branch-and-target-path
    technique:
      name: naming-conventions
      inputs:
        issue_title: "{issue_title}"
  - kind: technique
    id: create-component-worktree
    technique: git::create-worktree
    when: is_review_mode != true
  - kind: technique
    id: create-review-worktree
    technique:
      name: git::create-worktree
      inputs:
        create_branch: false
    when: is_review_mode == true
  - kind: technique
    id: check-branch
    technique: manage-git::verify-feature-branch
    actions:
      - action: validate
        target: on_feature_branch != false
        message: "The worktree at {target_path} is on a default branch, not a feature branch, so subsequent commits would land there. Check out {branch_name} in {target_path} and re-run."
  - kind: technique
    id: check-pr
    technique:
      name: github::list-prs
      inputs:
        repo_path: component_git_dir
    when: is_review_mode != true
    actions:
      - action: set
        target: pr_exists
        description: true when list-prs returned a PR for the current branch head, false otherwise
      - action: set
        target: existing_pr_number
        description: PR number from the list-prs result when one was found
      - action: set
        target: use_existing_pr
        description: true when pr_exists and an already-bound pr_number equals existing_pr_number (continue this work); otherwise leave the default false so pr-check can ask
      - action: set
        target: pr_number
        description: When use_existing_pr was set true by a pr_number/existing_pr_number match, bind pr_number from existing_pr_number; otherwise leave unchanged
  - kind: action
    id: announce-auto-use-existing-pr
    when: pr_exists == true && use_existing_pr == true
    actions:
      - action: message
        message: "Continuing with existing PR #{existing_pr_number} (already bound for this branch)."
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: pr-check
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: pr_exists
          operator: ==
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: use_existing_pr
          operator: "!="
          value: true
    message: "PR #{existing_pr_number} is already open for this branch."
    options:
      - id: use-existing
        label: Use existing PR
        description: Continue with the existing pull request
        effect:
          setVariable:
            use_existing_pr: true
            pr_number: "{existing_pr_number}"
      - id: create-new
        label: Create new PR
        description: Create a new draft pull request
        effect:
          setVariable:
            use_existing_pr: false
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: pr-creation
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_cancelled
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: use_existing_pr
          operator: "!="
          value: true
    message: "Feature branch {branch_name} and its worktree exist. No draft PR is open for the branch yet."
    defaultOption: proceed
    autoAdvanceMs: 30000
    options:
      - id: proceed
        label: Create draft PR
        description: Open a draft pull request from the feature branch, linked to the issue
        effect:
          setVariable:
            pr_skipped: false
      - id: skip-pr
        label: Skip PR for now
        description: Continue without a pull request (can create later)
        effect:
          setVariable:
            pr_skipped: true
  - kind: technique
    id: create-pr
    technique:
      name: update-pr::create-pr
      inputs:
        issue_number: "{issue_number}"
        issue_platform: "{issue_platform}"
    when: is_review_mode != true && use_existing_pr == false && pr_skipped != true
    actions:
      - action: set
        target: pr_exists
        value: true
        description: Mark PR as existing once successfully created.
  - kind: technique
    id: link-pr-to-ticket-jira
    technique:
      name: atlassian::comment-jira-issue
      inputs:
        issueIdOrKey: "{issue_number}"
        commentBody: "Pull Request: {pr_url}"
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: pr_number
          operator: exists
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_skipped
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_platform
          operator: ==
          value: jira
  - kind: technique
    id: link-pr-to-ticket-github
    technique:
      name: github::view-issue
      inputs:
        repo_path: component_git_dir
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: pr_number
          operator: exists
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_skipped
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_platform
          operator: ==
          value: github
  - kind: action
    id: announce-completion
    actions:
      - action: log
        message: Issue management complete - issue verified/created, PR ready
exits:
  - id: done
    isDefault: true
outcome:
  - Issue exists or is created in appropriate platform
  - Issue transitioned to In Progress and assigned to current user
  - A feature branch off {default_branch} carries the work
  - Draft PR created, assigned to current GitHub user, and linked to issue
  - PR reference recorded on the issue via the platform's native PR linkage

corpus/work-package/activities/02-design.text:
id: design-philosophy
version: 1.17.0
name: Design Philosophy
description: Apply the design framework to classify the problem and decide the workflow path.
variables:
  reads:
    - assumption_outcome
    - branch_name
    - component_git_dir
    - is_review_mode
    - issue_record
    - planning_folder_path
    - pr_number
    - problem_statement
    - requirements
    - target_path
    - target_repo
  writes:
    - name: assumptions_log
      type: object
      description: The assumptions log — every assumption with its category, agent position and resolution status, and the record of truth for assumption outcomes.
    - name: has_deferred_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any assumption was deferred to stakeholders.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_open_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether unresolved assumptions requiring stakeholder input remain.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_resolvable_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether code-resolvable assumptions exist that can be validated through targeted analysis.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: needs_comprehension
      type: boolean
      description: Whether codebase comprehension is outstanding.
      defaultValue: true
    - name: needs_elicitation
      type: boolean
      description: Whether requirements elicitation is needed.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: needs_research
      type: boolean
      description: Whether research phase is needed.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: open_assumptions
      type: array
      description: The residual open assumptions awaiting a stakeholder judgement.
    - name: problem_complexity
      type: string
      description: How complex the problem is, as assessed during design-philosophy.
      values:
        - simple
        - moderate
        - complex
    - name: problem_statement
      type: string
      description: A clear problem definition with system understanding, impact assessment, success criteria, and constraints — understandable without prior context.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: problem_type
      type: string
      description: Problem or inventive-goal classification (e.g. defect, inventive-improvement).
    - name: skip_optional_activities
      type: boolean
      description: Whether to skip optional discovery activities (elicitation and research).
      defaultValue: false
    - name: ticket_disposition
      type: string
      description: What the reviewer decided about the ticket's completeness gaps. Absent outside review mode, where the gaps are not assessed.
      values:
        - refactor
        - gaps-noted
        - complete
    - name: ticket_gaps_documented
      type: boolean
      description: Whether ticket completeness gaps were documented during review mode design-philosophy assessment.
      defaultValue: false
required: true
techniques:
  - scatter-gather
steps:
  - kind: technique
    id: define-problem
    technique: define
  - kind: technique
    id: classify-problem
    technique: classify
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: classification-confirmed
    condition:
      type: simple
      variable: is_review_mode
      operator: "!="
      value: true
    message: "Classification: {problem_type}. Rationale: {classification_rationale}."
    options:
      - id: classification-accurate
        label: Classification accurate
        description: The problem type and complexity assessment describe the work
      - id: revise-classification
        label: Revise classification
        description: The problem type or complexity assessment needs adjustment
        effect:
          exit: revise-classification
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: workflow-path-selected
    condition:
      type: simple
      variable: is_review_mode
      operator: "!="
      value: true
    message: "The discovery activities this work package runs before planning."
    options:
      - id: full-workflow
        label: Full workflow (elicitation + research)
        description: Complex feature requiring requirements discovery and research
        effect:
          setVariable:
            problem_complexity: complex
            needs_elicitation: true
            needs_research: true
            skip_optional_activities: false
      - id: elicitation-only
        label: Elicitation only (skip research)
        description: Requirements unclear but domain is well-understood
        effect:
          setVariable:
            problem_complexity: moderate
            needs_elicitation: true
            needs_research: false
            skip_optional_activities: false
      - id: research-only
        label: Research only (skip elicitation)
        description: Requirements clear but need to research best practices
        effect:
          setVariable:
            problem_complexity: moderate
            needs_elicitation: false
            needs_research: true
            skip_optional_activities: false
      - id: skip-optional
        label: Skip optional activities
        description: Well-defined issue — no additional discovery needed
        effect:
          setVariable:
            problem_complexity: simple
            needs_elicitation: false
            needs_research: false
            skip_optional_activities: true
  - kind: technique
    id: determine-path
    technique: determine-path
  - kind: technique
    id: document-philosophy
    technique: document
    actions:
      - action: message
        message: "[Design philosophy]({design_philosophy_doc}) recorded — the record of truth for the classification and path rationale."
  - kind: technique
    id: collect-assumptions
    technique:
      name: review-assumptions::collect
      inputs:
        assumption_source: the problem statement, its classification, and the workflow path chosen from them
        assumption_categories: Problem Interpretation, Complexity Assessment, Workflow Path
  - kind: technique
    id: create-assumptions-log
    technique:
      name: review-assumptions::record
      inputs:
        assumption_source: the problem statement, its classification, and the workflow path chosen from them
        assumption_categories: Problem Interpretation, Complexity Assessment, Workflow Path
  - kind: routine
    id: assumption-convergence
    routine: converge-assumptions
    outputs:
      assumptions_log: assumptions_log
      has_resolvable_assumptions: has_resolvable_assumptions
      has_open_assumptions: has_open_assumptions
      open_assumptions: open_assumptions
  - kind: technique
    id: assess-ticket-completeness
    technique: assess-ticket-completeness
    when: is_review_mode == true
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: ticket-completeness
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: ==
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: ticket_gaps_documented
          operator: ==
          value: true
    message: The ticket carries completeness gaps.
    defaultOption: proceed-with-gaps
    autoAdvanceMs: 30000
    options:
      - id: refactor-ticket
        label: Refactor ticket
        description: Update the ticket to address identified gaps
        effect:
          setVariable:
            ticket_disposition: refactor
      - id: proceed-with-gaps
        label: Proceed with gaps noted
        description: The recorded gaps stand as tracked findings
        effect:
          setVariable:
            ticket_disposition: gaps-noted
      - id: no-gaps
        label: Ticket is complete
        description: No significant gaps were found
        effect:
          setVariable:
            ticket_disposition: complete
  - kind: action
    id: set-review-mode-path
    when: is_review_mode == true
    actions:
      - action: set
        target: needs_elicitation
        value: false
      - action: message
        message: "Review mode: classification recorded ({problem_type}, {problem_complexity} complexity). Rationale: {classification_rationale}."
exits:
  - id: revise-classification
    immediate: true
  - id: done
    isDefault: true
outcome:
  - Problem clearly defined and classified
  - Complexity assessed
  - Workflow path determined
  - A durable record of the classification and path rationale that downstream activities and reviewers can rely on

corpus/work-package/activities/03-requir.text:
id: requirements-elicitation
version: 2.12.0
name: Requirements Elicitation
description: Discover and clarify what the work package should accomplish through structured sequential conversation.
variables:
  reads:
    - assumption_outcome
    - branch_name
    - component_git_dir
    - needs_research
    - planning_folder_path
    - pr_number
    - problem_statement
    - requirements
    - target_path
    - target_repo
  writes:
    - name: assumptions_log
      type: object
      description: The assumptions log — every assumption with its category, agent position and resolution status, and the record of truth for assumption outcomes.
    - name: current_domain
      type: string
      description: The question domain the current elicitation question is drawn from.
    - name: current_question
      type: string
      description: The question posed for the domain under elicitation.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: domain_answered
      type: boolean
      description: Whether the posed question was answered, or its domain passed over.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: elicitation_complete
      type: boolean
      description: Whether requirements elicitation is finished.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: elicitation_log
      type: array
      description: One entry per question posed, carrying its domain, the question and the answer given.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: has_deferred_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any assumption was deferred to stakeholders.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_open_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether unresolved assumptions requiring stakeholder input remain.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_resolvable_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether code-resolvable assumptions exist that can be validated through targeted analysis.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: needs_elicitation
      type: boolean
      description: Whether requirements elicitation is needed.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: open_assumptions
      type: array
      description: The residual open assumptions awaiting a stakeholder judgement.
    - name: question_domains
      type: array
      description: The domains this run poses elicitation questions from.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: requirements
      type: array
      description: The captured requirements list elicited across the domains.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: stakeholder_baseline
      type: string
      description: The stakeholder discussion as elicitation reads it, or the recorded limitation that none was held.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: stakeholder_discussion_held
      type: boolean
      description: Whether a stakeholder discussion took place before agent-led elicitation.
      defaultValue: false
required: false
steps:
  - kind: action
    id: announce-start
    actions:
      - action: log
        message: Eliciting requirements
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: stakeholder-discussion-held
    message: Stakeholder discussion before agent-led elicitation gives the questions something to build on.
    options:
      - id: transcript-provided
        label: Transcript provided
        description: The reply carries the discussion transcript or summary
        effect:
          setVariable:
            stakeholder_discussion_held: true
      - id: skip-discussion
        label: Proceed without stakeholder discussion
        description: Elicitation runs on agent-led questions alone, with the limitation recorded against the requirements
        effect:
          setVariable:
            stakeholder_discussion_held: false
  - kind: technique
    id: stakeholder-discussion
    technique: discuss
  - kind: technique
    id: select-domains
    technique: select-domains
  - kind: loop

    maxIterations: 5
    steps:

            effect:

  - kind: technique
    id: elicit-requirements

  - kind: technique
    id: collect-assumptions
    technique:

  - kind: technique
    id: create-document

  - kind: technique
    id: update-assumptions-log

  - kind: checkpoint
    id: elicitation-complete
    message: Every question domain has been covered.

    autoAdvanceMs: 30000
    options:

corpus/work-package/activities/04-resear.text:
id: research
version: 2.19.0
name: Research
description: Research the knowledge base and external sources to discover best practices, patterns, and resources to inform the plan-prepare activity.
variables:
  reads:
    - assumption_outcome
    - branch_name
    - component_git_dir
    - planning_folder_path
    - pr_number
    - problem_statement
    - requirements
    - target_path
    - target_repo
  writes:

      type: object
      description: Judgement-augmentation context per open assumption — decision space, non-resolvability rationale, technical context, agent's position, reversibility — with a link to the assumptions log.
    - name: assumptions_log
      type: object
      description: The assumptions log — every assumption with its category, agent position and resolution status, and the record of truth for assumption outcomes.
    - name: context_scope
      type: string
      description: Provenance scope of AI-generated code in this work package.
      values:
        - repo-only
        - web-retrieval
        - mixed
      defaultValue: repo-only
    - name: context_scope_uncertain
      type: boolean
      description: True when research run evidence cannot decide repo-only vs web-retrieval vs mixed for context_scope.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_deferred_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any assumption was deferred to stakeholders.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_open_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether unresolved assumptions requiring stakeholder input remain.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_reconcilable_research
      type: boolean
      description: Whether open research-reconcilable candidates remain — gaps further knowledge-base or web research could close.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_resolvable_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether code-resolvable assumptions exist that can be validated through targeted analysis.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: needs_research
      type: boolean
      description: Whether research phase is needed.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: open_assumptions
      type: array
      description: The residual open assumptions awaiting a stakeholder judgement.
    - name: research_candidates
      type: array
      description: Inventory of open research gaps, each triaged as reconcilable-by-research or irreconcilable, with its rationale.
required: false
techniques:
  - scatter-gather
steps:
  - kind: technique
    id: research-knowledge-base
    technique: research
  - kind: technique
    id: synthesize
    technique: synthesize
  - kind: technique
    id: triage-research-candidates
    technique: triage
  - kind: loop
    id: research-reconciliation
    name: Research Reconciliation Loop
    loopType: doWhile
    continueWhile:
      type: simple
      variable: has_reconcilable_research
      operator: ==
      value: true
    maxIterations: 10
    steps:
      - kind: technique
        id: reconcile-research-candidates
        technique: reconcile
        when: has_reconcilable_research == true
      - kind: checkpoint
        id: research-convergence
        condition:
          type: simple
          variable: has_reconcilable_research
          operator: ==
          value: false
        message: "Research has converged. Full candidate inventory ([Open Research Candidates]({research_document})): {research_candidates}."
        defaultOption: accept-research
        autoAdvanceMs: 30000
        options:
          - id: accept-research
            label: Accept — proceed to planning
            description: Research is complete; the remaining open candidates are irreconcilable by research.
          - id: request-more
            label: Direct further research
            description: The reply names the candidate and the focus for a further research pass.
            effect:
              setVariable:
                has_reconcilable_research: true
  - kind: technique
    id: collect-assumptions
    technique:
      name: review-assumptions::collect
      inputs:
        assumption_categories: Pattern Applicability, Source Relevance, Synthesis Decisions, Risk Assessment
  - kind: technique
    id: document
    technique: document
  - kind: technique
    id: update-assumptions-log
    technique: review-assumptions::record
  - kind: routine
    id: assumption-convergence
    routine: converge-assumptions
    outputs:
      assumptions_log: assumptions_log
      has_resolvable_assumptions: has_resolvable_assumptions
      has_open_assumptions: has_open_assumptions
      open_assumptions: open_assumptions
  - kind: technique
    id: present-resolved-assumptions
    technique: review-assumptions::assemble-open-set
    actions:
      - action: message
        message: |-
          **Assumptions**

          {assumption_review_presentation}
  - kind: action
    id: close-research-phase
    actions:
      - action: set
        target: needs_research
        value: false
  - kind: action
    id: announce-derived-context-scope
    when: context_scope_uncertain != true
    actions:
      - action: message
        message: "Research context scope derived as `{context_scope}`."
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: context-scope-declaration
    condition:
      type: simple
      variable: context_scope_uncertain
      operator: ==
      value: true
    message: The research run's evidence settles no single provenance scope for the sources that informed the design.
    defaultOption: repo-only
    autoAdvanceMs: 15000
    options:
      - id: repo-only
        label: Repository only — no external web sources used
        description: All research was based on codebase and local knowledge (default)
        effect:
          setVariable:
            context_scope: repo-only
            context_scope_uncertain: false
      - id: web-retrieval
        label: External web sources used for design decisions
        description: Web search, external docs, or third-party references informed the approach
        effect:
          setVariable:
            context_scope: web-retrieval
            context_scope_uncertain: false
      - id: mixed
        label: Both repository and external sources used
        description: Mix of codebase analysis and external references
        effect:
          setVariable:
            context_scope: mixed
            context_scope_uncertain: false
exits:
  - id: done
    isDefault: true
outcome:
  - Best practices identified from multiple sources
  - Patterns validated and mapped to requirements
  - Risks and anti-patterns documented

id: assumptions-review

name: Assumptions Review

variables:

  writes:

      defaultValue: ""
    - name: assumption_review_presentation
      type: object
      description: Judgement-augmentation context per open assumption — decision space, non-resolvability rationale, technical context, agent's position, reversibility — with a link to the assumptions log.
    - name: assumptions_log
      type: object
      description: The assumptions log — every assumption with its category, agent position and resolution status, and the record of truth for assumption outcomes.
    - name: deferred_items_register

      type: boolean

      type: boolean

      defaultValue: false
    - name: open_assumptions
      type: array
      description: The residual open assumptions awaiting a stakeholder judgement.
    - name: post_summary_approved
      type: boolean
      description: Whether the deferred-assumptions summary is posted to the issue tracker, as decided at the post-summary-review gate.
      defaultValue: false
required: true
techniques:
  - scatter-gather
steps:

    id: evaluate-open-assumptions
    technique: review-assumptions::collect
  - kind: routine
    id: assumption-convergence
    routine: converge-assumptions
    outputs:
      assumptions_log: assumptions_log
      has_resolvable_assumptions: has_resolvable_assumptions
      has_open_assumptions: has_open_assumptions
      open_assumptions: open_assumptions
  - kind: technique
    id: present-residual-assumptions
    technique: review-assumptions::assemble-open-set
    when: is_review_mode != true
  - kind: routine
    id: residual-assumptions
    routine: residual-assumption-interview
    outputs:
      assumption_outcome: assumption_outcome
      has_deferred_assumptions: has_deferred_assumptions
  - kind: technique

        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: issue_platform
          operator: exists
        - type: simple
          variable: has_deferred_assumptions
          operator: ==

corpus/work-package/activities/08-implem.text:
id: implement
version: 2.20.0
name: Implement Tasks
description: Execute the implementation plan task by task.
variables:
  reads:
    - branch_name
    - component_git_dir
    - has_uncertain_symbols
    - host_repo_path
    - implementation_plan
    - is_review_mode
    - planning_folder_path
    - pr_number
    - problem_statement
    - project_type
    - requirements
    - target_path
    - target_repo
  writes:
    - name: assumption_outcome
      type: string
      description: The outcome given the assumption under discussion. Empty before one has been decided.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: assumption_review_presentation
      type: object
      description: Judgement-augmentation context per open assumption — decision space, non-resolvability rationale, technical context, agent's position, reversibility — with a link to the assumptions log.
    - name: assumptions_log
      type: object
      description: The assumptions log — every assumption with its category, agent position and resolution status, and the record of truth for assumption outcomes.
    - name: changed_paths
      type: array
      description: Repository-relative paths the task under construction wrote.
    - name: commit_sha
      type: string
      description: SHA of the commit carrying the task under construction, empty where it staged nothing.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: current_task
      type: object
      description: The implementation-plan task under construction.
    - name: failures
      type: array
      description: Per-test failure detail when any failed
      defaultValue: []
    - name: has_deferred_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any assumption was deferred to stakeholders.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_open_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether unresolved assumptions requiring stakeholder input remain.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_resolvable_assumptions
      type: boolean
      description: Whether code-resolvable assumptions exist that can be validated through targeted analysis.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_uncertain_symbols
      type: boolean
      description: True when one or more symbols in the task under construction have unconfirmed provenance.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: open_assumptions
      type: array
      description: The residual open assumptions awaiting a stakeholder judgement.
    - name: test_status
      type: object
      description: "The test check's status — `{ check_id, passed, diagnostics }`."
      defaultValue: {}
    - name: uncertain_symbols
      type: string
      description: "Symbols whose provenance could not be confirmed against the codebase or declared dependencies, one per line."
      defaultValue: ""
required: true
techniques:
  - scatter-gather
steps:
  - kind: loop
    id: task-cycle
    name: Task Implementation Cycle
    loopType: forEach
    variable: current_task
    over: implementation_plan.tasks
    steps:
      - kind: technique
        id: implement-task
        technique: implement-task
      - kind: technique
        id: run-tests
        technique:
          name: cargo::test
          inputs:
            build_scope: -p {current_task.crate}
        when: project_type == 'rust-substrate'
      - kind: technique
        id: commit
        technique:
          name: manage-git::commit-paths
          inputs:
            paths: changed_paths
            commit_message: "{current_task.description}"
      - kind: technique
        id: log-provenance
        technique:
          name: dco-provenance::append-task-row
          inputs:
            task_id: "{current_task.id}"
            task_description: "{current_task.description}"
      - kind: loop
        id: provenance-settle-cycle
        name: Symbol Provenance Settle Cycle
        loopType: doWhile
        continueWhile:
          type: simple
          variable: has_uncertain_symbols
          operator: ==
          value: true
        maxIterations: 3
        steps:
          - kind: technique
            id: self-review
            technique: task-completion-review

            id: symbol-provenance-confirmed
            condition:
              type: simple
              variable: has_uncertain_symbols
              operator: ==
              value: true
            message: |-

            options:
              - id: confirmed
                label: Symbols are intentional
                description: The flagged symbols were introduced intentionally by this task, or were verified by hand.
                effect:
                  setVariable:
                    has_uncertain_symbols: false
              - id: uncertain
                label: Trace the flagged symbols again
                description: The flagged symbols remain unaccounted for and the task's self-review runs again over them.
                effect:
                  setVariable:
                    has_uncertain_symbols: true
      - kind: technique
        id: collect-assumptions
        technique: review-assumptions::collect
  - kind: routine
    id: assumption-convergence
    routine: converge-assumptions
    outputs:
      assumptions_log: assumptions_log
      has_resolvable_assumptions: has_resolvable_assumptions
      has_open_assumptions: has_open_assumptions
      open_assumptions: open_assumptions
  - kind: technique
    id: present-resolved-assumptions
    technique: review-assumptions::assemble-open-set
    when: is_review_mode != true
    actions:
      - action: message
        message: |-
          **Assumptions**

          {assumption_review_presentation}
  - kind: routine
    id: residual-assumptions
    routine: residual-assumption-interview
    outputs:
      assumption_outcome: assumption_outcome
      has_deferred_assumptions: has_deferred_assumptions
  - kind: technique
    id: update-assumptions-log
    technique: review-assumptions::record
exits:
  - id: done
    isDefault: true
outcome:
  - All tasks implemented
  - The implemented work is captured as reviewable, attributable commits on the feature branch
  - An auditable per-task record of what changed and why exists to support the later DCO attestation

corpus/work-package/activities/09-lean-c.text:
id: lean-coding-audit
version: 1.8.0
name: Lean-Coding Audit
description: Apply the ponytail lean-coding lens to the just-implemented change.
variables:
  reads:
    - floor_breached
    - is_review_mode
  writes:
    - name: floor_breached
      type: boolean
      description: Whether an applied simplification breaches the safety floor and the cycle owes another pass to restore it.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_debt_markers
      type: boolean
      description: Whether at least one ponytail debt marker was found in the tree.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: lean_audit_findings
      type: array
      description: The lean-coding audit's findings, each under a stable `LC-{n}` designator carrying its taxonomy tag, location, simpler alternative and the lines it would save, closing with the diff-scoped scoreboard.
    - name: needs_simplification
      type: boolean
      description: Whether accepted simplifications remain to apply.
      defaultValue: false
required: true
steps:
  - kind: technique
    id: review-over-engineering
    technique:
      name: ponytail/review-over-engineering
      outputs:
        review_findings: lean_audit_findings
  - kind: technique
    id: harvest-debt
    technique: ponytail/harvest-debt
  - kind: technique
    id: report-gain
    technique: ponytail/report-gain
    when: has_debt_markers == true
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: audit-findings-confirmed
    condition:
      type: simple
      variable: is_review_mode
      operator: "!="
      value: true
    message: "Lean-coding audit findings against the over-engineering taxonomy, closing with the diff-scoped scoreboard: {lean_audit_findings}"
    options:
      - id: audit-accepted
        label: Accept audit — no changes to apply
        description: The audit findings and scoreboard are accurate.
      - id: apply-simplifications
        label: Apply recommended simplifications
        description: The accepted simplifications are worth applying to the change.
        effect:
          setVariable:
            needs_simplification: true
      - id: audit-findings-disputed
        label: Findings need correction
        description: The findings require correction; record the dispute and apply no simplifications this pass.
        effect:
          setVariable:
            needs_simplification: false
  - kind: loop
    id: simplification-apply-cycle
    name: Simplification Apply Cycle
    loopType: while
    when: is_review_mode != true
    continueWhile:
      type: or
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: needs_simplification
          operator: ==
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: floor_breached
          operator: ==
          value: true
    maxIterations: 3
    steps:
      - kind: technique
        id: apply-simplifications
        technique: ponytail/apply-ladder
      - kind: technique
        id: re-review-over-engineering
        technique:
          name: ponytail/review-over-engineering
          outputs:
            review_findings: lean_audit_findings
      - kind: checkpoint
        id: safety-floor-cleared
        message: "The applied simplifications stand re-scored against the over-engineering taxonomy, with every safety-floor obligation the change implicates either satisfied or still open."
        options:
          - id: floor-held-cycle-complete
            label: Floor held — no accepted simplifications remain
            description: Every applied simplification clears the floor and the re-score surfaces none left to apply.
            effect:
              setVariable:
                needs_simplification: false
                floor_breached: false
          - id: floor-held-more-remain
            label: Floor held — accepted simplifications remain
            description: The re-score still surfaces accepted simplifications that clear the floor.
            effect:
              setVariable:
                needs_simplification: true
                floor_breached: false
          - id: floor-breached
            label: Floor breached — restore the floor before review
            description: An applied simplification breaches the floor, so the cycle takes another pass to restore the obligation it dropped.
            effect:
              setVariable:
                needs_simplification: false
                floor_breached: true
exits:
  - id: done
    isDefault: true
outcome:
  - The change is tagged and scored against the over-engineering taxonomy
  - Every deliberate simplification is harvested into a tracked debt ledger with its upgrade trigger and honest gain
  - Accepted simplifications are applied without breaching the safety floor

corpus/work-package/activities/10-post-i.text:
id: post-impl-review
version: 2.1.0
name: Post-Implementation Review
description: Review implementation quality before validation.
variables:
  reads:
    - base_branch
    - block_line_range
    - block_path
    - branch_name
    - changed_files
    - commit_sha
    - component_git_dir
    - component_name
    - component_path
    - host_repo_path
    - is_review_mode
    - issue_title
    - planning_folder_path
    - pr_number
    - problem_complexity
    - problem_statement
    - push_remote
    - requirements
    - target_path
    - target_repo
  writes:
    - name: coverage_gaps
      type: array
      description: Changed symbols no test file calls.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: update_candidates
      type: array
      description: Changed symbols a test file calls against a signature or behaviour the change moved.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: change_block_index
      type: string
      description: Absolute path to the index mapping change-block IDs to their per-block artifacts.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: classified_findings
      type: array
      description: "The input findings, each carrying its assigned severity, its `action_tier`, and its `impact_axis` where one applies."
    - name: code_findings_actionable
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any code-review finding is at or above the severity that warrants action.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: current_activity
      type: string
      description: The prism activity the walk holds, and null once the prism graph routes to none.
    - name: current_block_index
      type: number
      description: Current block index during manual diff review loop (from flagged_block_indices).
      defaultValue: 0
    - name: flagged_block_indices
      type: array
      description: Change-block indices the reviewer flagged as carrying an issue.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: follow_up_rows
      type: array
      description: In-task follow-ups to append to the register, each with what remains and where it surfaced.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: follow_ups_register
      type: string
      description: The in-task follow-ups register as it stands after this activity's rows.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: from_activity
      type: string
      description: The prism activity an advance retires.
    - name: has_critical_blocker
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any flagged block is a critical blocker.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: has_flagged_blocks
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any change block carries an issue.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: rationale_attested
      type: boolean
      description: True once every change block's rationale paragraph is confirmed to describe the change it sits under.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: reviewed_code_base_url
      type: string
      description: Permanent blob-URL prefix for reviewed-code citations, down to the full head sha.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: run_local_validation
      type: boolean
      description: True when the user permits running the project validation suite locally.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: structural_findings
      type: array
      description: The structural-analysis findings for this change, from whichever pipeline produced them.
    - name: run_status
      type: string
      description: The launched prism run's verdict on its own completeness. Absent where no run was launched.
      values:
        - complete
        - partial
        - error
    - name: test_findings_actionable
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any test-suite finding is at or above the severity that warrants action.
      defaultValue: false
required: true
triggers:
  - workflow: prism
    description: The full analytical pipeline over the change surface.
    passContext:
      - target_path
      - component_name
      - issue_title
steps:
  - kind: action
    id: announce-start
    actions:
      - action: log
        message: Starting post-implementation review
  - kind: technique
    id: manual-diff-review
    technique: review-diff
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: file-index-table
    message: "[Change-block index]({change_block_index}), its block titles linking to file:line."
    options:
      - id: no-flagged-blocks
        label: No blocks carry an issue
        description: Every change block reads as intended
      - id: flagged-blocks
        label: Some blocks carry an issue
        description: The reply names the block numbers, comma-separated
        effect:
          setVariable:
            has_flagged_blocks: true
  - kind: technique
    id: collect-flagged-blocks
    technique: review-diff
    when: has_flagged_blocks == true
  - kind: technique
    id: register-review-follow-ups
    technique: manage-registers::append-follow-up
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: rationale-attestation
    message: "Block rationale in the [change-block index]({change_block_index}), which your confirmation attests the provenance of."
    options:
      - id: rationale-accurate
        label: Rationale accurate as written
        description: Every rationale paragraph describes the change it sits under
        effect:
          setVariable:
            rationale_attested: true
      - id: rationale-corrected
        label: Rationale needs correction
        description: The reply carries the corrections
        effect:
          setVariable:
            rationale_attested: false
  - kind: technique
    id: re-render-block-rationale
    technique: review-diff
    when: rationale_attested == false
  - kind: loop
    id: block-interview-loop
    name: Block Interview Loop
    loopType: forEach
    variable: current_block_index
    over: flagged_block_indices
    maxIterations: 50
    when: has_flagged_blocks == true
    steps:
      - kind: checkpoint
        id: block-interview#{current_block_index}
        message: "Block {current_block_index}: {block_path}:{block_line_range}"
        defaultOption: issue-recorded
        autoAdvanceMs: 30000
        options:
          - id: issue-recorded
            label: Issue recorded - continue
            description: The issue with this change is recorded and it does not block
          - id: critical-blocker
            label: This is a critical blocker
            description: Mark as blocking issue that must be fixed
            effect:
              setVariable:
                has_critical_blocker: true
          - id: skip-block
            label: Skip this block
            description: The block carries no issue after all
  - kind: technique
    id: code-review
    technique: review-code
  - kind: technique
    id: structural-analysis-inline
    when: problem_complexity != 'complex'
    technique:
      name: prism/structural-analysis
      outputs:
        structural_analysis: structural_findings
  - kind: technique
    id: dispatch-prism
    when: problem_complexity == 'complex'
    technique:
      name: workflow-engine::handle-sub-workflow
      inputs:
        workflow_id: prism
  - kind: routine
    id: walk-prism-child
    when: problem_complexity == 'complex'
    routine: activity-loop
    with:
      session_index: child_session_index
      initial_activity: child_initial_activity
      enter_activity: workflow-engine::take-activity
      planning_folder_path: child_planning_folder_path
    outputs:
      current_activity: current_activity
      from_activity: from_activity
  - kind: technique
    id: read-prism-manifest
    when: problem_complexity == 'complex'
    technique:
      name: prism/read-run-manifest
      inputs:
        output_path: child_planning_folder_path
    actions:
      - action: validate
        target: run_status != 'error'
        message: "The prism run reported `{run_status}` — its report or definitive findings is missing or empty. Re-run the prism launch for this change."
  - kind: technique
    id: read-prism-findings
    when: problem_complexity == 'complex'
    technique:
      name: prism/read-definitive-findings
      outputs:
        definitive_findings: structural_findings
  - kind: routine
    id: map-diff-coverage
    routine: gitnexus::diff-coverage-map
    outputs:
      coverage_gaps: coverage_gaps
      update_candidates: update_candidates
  - kind: technique
    id: test-suite-review
    technique: review-test-suite
  - kind: technique
    id: classify-and-route-findings
    technique:
      name: findings-classification
      inputs:
        findings_to_classify: manual_diff_review_report
        code_review_findings: code_review_report
        test_review_findings: test_suite_review_report
        structural_findings: structural_findings
  - kind: loop
    id: review-fix-cycle
    name: Review-Fix Cycle
    loopType: while
    when: is_review_mode != true
    continueWhile:
      type: or
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: code_findings_actionable
          operator: ==
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: test_findings_actionable
          operator: ==
          value: true
    maxIterations: 3
    steps:
      - kind: technique
        id: apply-fixes
        technique: apply-review-fixes
      - kind: action
        id: reset-fix-flags
        actions:
          - action: set
            target: code_findings_actionable
            value: false
          - action: set
            target: test_findings_actionable
            value: false
      - kind: technique
        id: re-manual-diff-review
        technique: review-diff
      - kind: technique
        id: re-code-review
        technique: review-code
      - kind: routine
        id: remap-diff-coverage
        routine: gitnexus::diff-coverage-map
        outputs:
          coverage_gaps: coverage_gaps
          update_candidates: update_candidates
      - kind: technique
        id: re-test-suite-review
        technique: review-test-suite
      - kind: technique
        id: reclassify-findings
        technique:
          name: findings-classification
          inputs:
            findings_to_classify: manual_diff_review_report
            code_review_findings: code_review_report
            test_review_findings: test_suite_review_report
            structural_findings: structural_findings
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: local-validation-permission
    message: The project's validation suite has not been exercised against the checked-out head.
    condition:
      type: simple
      variable: has_critical_blocker
      operator: "!="
      value: true
    options:
      - id: run-suite
        label: Run the suite against the checked-out head
        description: This environment can run the project suite
        effect:
          setVariable:
            run_local_validation: true
      - id: suite-not-run
        label: Record validation as not run
        description: This environment cannot run the project suite
        effect:
          setVariable:
            run_local_validation: false
exits:
  - id: has-blocker
    when: has_critical_blocker == true
  - id: done
    isDefault: true
outcome:
  - Every change block has a confirmed rationale and provenance attestation, so reviewers can trust each change is understood and intentional
  - Code-level defects and risks are surfaced and triaged before validation
  - Structural risks across the change set are identified for triage
  - Test coverage gaps are surfaced so they can be closed before validation

corpus/work-package/activities/11-valida.text:
id: validate
version: 3.11.0
name: Verify & Validate Design
description: Validate the implementation against tests, build, format, and lint checks when the local environment can run them.
variables:
  reads:
    - branch_name
    - changed_files
    - component_git_dir
    - component_path
    - failures
    - host_repo_path
    - is_review_mode
    - planning_folder_path
    - pr_number
    - problem_statement
    - project_type
    - requirements
    - run_local_validation
    - target_path
    - target_repo
    - test_status
  writes:
    - name: coverage_gaps
      type: array
      description: Changed symbols no test file calls.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: update_candidates
      type: array
      description: Changed symbols a test file calls against a signature or behaviour the change moved.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: classified_findings
      type: array
      description: "The input findings, each carrying its assigned severity, its `action_tier`, and its `impact_axis` where one applies."
    - name: code_findings_actionable
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any code-review finding is at or above the severity that warrants action.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: mark_progress_na
      type: boolean
      description: True when the activity's Progress row records cancelled/N/A rather than complete.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: test_findings_actionable
      type: boolean
      description: Whether any test-suite finding is at or above the severity that warrants action.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: validation_results
      type: object
      description: Aggregate validation envelope from the cargo suite, carrying each check's status and the run's overall verdict.
required: true
steps:
  - kind: action
    id: mark-validation-na
    when: run_local_validation == false
    actions:
      - action: set
        target: mark_progress_na
        value: true
  - kind: technique
    id: preflight
    technique: cargo::preflight
    when: project_type == 'rust-substrate' && run_local_validation == true
    actions:
      - action: validate
        target: missing_prerequisites.length == 0
        message: "Toolchain prerequisites are unmet, so the validation suite cannot run: {missing_prerequisites}"
  - kind: technique
    id: run-suite
    technique:
      name: cargo::run-suite
      inputs:
        build_scope: --workspace
    when: project_type == 'rust-substrate' && run_local_validation == true
  - kind: technique
    id: document-failures
    technique:
      name: findings-classification
      inputs:
        findings_to_classify: "{validation_results.failed_checks}"
    when: is_review_mode == true && project_type == 'rust-substrate' && run_local_validation == true
  - kind: routine
    id: map-diff-coverage
    routine: gitnexus::diff-coverage-map
    when: is_review_mode == true
    outputs:
      coverage_gaps: coverage_gaps
      update_candidates: update_candidates
  - kind: technique
    id: assess-test-coverage
    technique: review-test-suite
    when: is_review_mode == true
  - kind: loop
    id: fix-revalidate-cycle
    name: Fix and Revalidate Cycle
    loopType: while
    when: is_review_mode != true
    continueWhile:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: run_local_validation
          operator: ==
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: project_type
          operator: ==
          value: rust-substrate
        - type: simple
          variable: validation_results.validation_passed
          operator: ==
          value: false
    maxIterations: 10
    steps:
      - kind: technique
        id: analyze-failure
        technique:
          name: validate-build::analyze-failure
          inputs:
            check_id: "{validation_results.first_failure.check_id}"
            failure_diagnostics: "{validation_results.first_failure.diagnostics}"
      - kind: technique
        id: apply-fix
        technique:
          name: validate-build::apply-fix
          inputs:
            check_id: "{validation_results.first_failure.check_id}"
      - kind: technique
        id: revalidate
        technique:
          name: cargo::run-suite
          inputs:
            build_scope: --workspace
exits:
  - id: done
    isDefault: true
outcome:
  - The suite's verdict on the change is established, or recorded as unavailable in this environment
  - The build stands green where the suite ran here

corpus/work-package/activities/12-strate.text:
id: strategic-review
version: 2.22.0
name: Strategic Review
description: Review the implementation to ensure changes are minimal and focused.
variables:
  reads:
    - branch_name
    - changed_files
    - component_git_dir
    - component_path
    - host_repo_path
    - is_review_mode
    - issue_number
    - issue_platform
    - issue_url
    - planning_folder_path
    - pr_number
    - problem_statement
    - push_remote
    - requirements
    - review_summary
    - stealth_mode
    - target_path
    - target_repo
  writes:
    - name: scope_findings
      type: array
      description: Affected execution flows falling outside the requirements, each with the changed symbol that reaches it.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: orphan_candidates
      type: array
      description: Symbols in the changed files that nothing references — over-engineering and dead-code candidates.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: package_diagram_source
      type: array
      description: The functional areas the change reaches, each with its members, which the package diagram is drawn from.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: sequence_diagram_source
      type: array
      description: The ordered step trace of each execution flow the change runs through, which the sequence diagrams are drawn from.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: base_branch
      type: string
      description: The branch the pull request targets, as the platform reports it.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: body_conforms
      type: boolean
      description: True once the rendered PR body satisfies every conformance criterion in the pr-description guide.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: body_findings
      type: array
      description: List of PR-body conformance violations.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: deferred_item_rows
      type: array
      description: Deferrals to append to the out-of-scope register, each with what was set aside and why.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: deferred_items_register
      type: string
      description: The out-of-scope deferrals register as it stands after this activity's rows.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: head_sha
      type: string
      description: Commit sha at the head of the pull request's branch.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: pr_body
      type: string
      description: The pull request's description body as the platform returned it.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: pr_url
      type: string
      description: URL of the pull request for this work package (alongside pr_number).
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: raised_findings_scope
      type: string
      description: How much of the findings set the posted review carries to the pull request author.
      values:
        - all
        - selected
        - none
      defaultValue: all
    - name: recommended_strategic_option
      type: string
      description: The action the agent recommends after its strategic-review analysis.
      values:
        - fix-findings
        - raise-findings
        - acceptable
    - name: rendered_pr_body
      type: string
      description: The body now live on the PR after the patch.
    - name: resign_unsigned_commits_requested
      type: boolean
      description: Whether the unsigned commits in the branch range are to be re-signed.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: review_passed
      type: boolean
      description: Whether strategic review passed.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: reviewed_code_base_url
      type: string
      description: Permanent blob-URL prefix for reviewed-code citations, down to the full head sha.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: strategic_findings_disposition
      type: string
      description: What the user decided about the strategic-review findings. Absent until the findings gate settles one.
      values:
        - acceptable
        - fix-all
        - fix-selected
        - deferred
        - re-review
    - name: strategic_findings_summary
      type: string
      description: Concise multi-line summary of strategic-review findings (severity tag + one-line description per finding).
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: strategic_review_findings
      type: array
      description: The findings the scope and artifact review produced, each under the designator its report defines.
    - name: unsigned_commit_list_summary
      type: string
      description: Short human-readable summary of the unsigned commits; empty when every commit is signed.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: unsigned_commits_in_pr
      type: boolean
      description: True when any commit in the branch range lacks a valid GPG signature.
      defaultValue: false
required: true
steps:
  - kind: technique
    id: read-live-pr-body
    technique:
      name: github::view-pr
      inputs:
        repo_path: component_git_dir
    condition:
      type: simple
      variable: pr_number
      operator: exists
  - kind: technique
    id: verify-pr-body
    technique:
      name: update-pr::verify-body
      inputs:
        rendered_pr_body: pr_body
    condition:
      type: simple
      variable: pr_number
      operator: exists
  - kind: routine
    id: check-scope-discipline
    routine: gitnexus::scope-discipline-check
    with:
      requirements_scope: "{requirements}"
    outputs:
      scope_findings: scope_findings
  - kind: routine
    id: scan-orphans
    routine: gitnexus::orphan-scan
    outputs:
      orphan_candidates: orphan_candidates
  - kind: technique
    id: review-strategy
    technique: review-scope
  - kind: technique
    id: refresh-pr-body
    technique:
      name: update-pr::render
      inputs:
        pr_template_variant: final
    when: is_review_mode != true && stealth_mode != true
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: unsigned-commits-prompt
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: unsigned_commits_in_pr
          operator: ==
          value: true
    message: "Commits without a valid GPG signature in this branch range: {unsigned_commit_list_summary}. Re-signing rewrites branch history and may require a force-with-lease push."
    options:
      - id: resign-all
        label: Yes — re-sign all unsigned commits
        description: Every unsigned commit in the range carries a signature afterwards
        effect:
          setVariable:
            resign_unsigned_commits_requested: true
      - id: decline-resign
        label: No — proceed without re-signing
        description: The history stands as it is, with its unsigned commits noted
        effect:
          setVariable:
            resign_unsigned_commits_requested: false
  - kind: technique
    id: resign-unsigned-commits
    technique: resign-commits
    when: is_review_mode != true && resign_unsigned_commits_requested == true
  - kind: technique
    id: verify-artifact-conformance
    technique:
      name: verify-artifact-conforms
      inputs:
        canonical_home_map: work-package/canonical-home-map
        guide_map: work-package/README#planning-artifact-to-guide-map
  - kind: technique
    id: verify-readme
    technique:
      name: workflow-engine::verify-readme-conforms
      inputs:
        seed_profile: work-package/readme-seed
  - kind: technique
    id: ensure-changes-folder-entry
    technique: changes-folder
  - kind: technique
    id: verify-change-fragment
    technique: verify-fragment
    actions:
      - action: validate
        target: fragment_references_issue != false
        message: "Change fragment for this work package does not reference `{issue_url}`. Add a `Closes: #{issue_number}` line (GitHub) or the full `{issue_url}` (when sibling fragments use that style) to the fragment body, commit, and re-run."
        condition:
          type: simple
          variable: stealth_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
  - kind: technique
    id: document-findings
    technique: document-findings
  - kind: technique
    id: register-deferred-findings
    technique: manage-registers::append-deferred-item
  - kind: technique
    id: document-cleanup-recommendations
    technique: recommend-cleanup
    when: is_review_mode == true
  - kind: technique
    id: apply-cleanup
    technique: apply-cleanup
    when: is_review_mode != true
  - kind: routine
    id: source-package-diagram
    routine: gitnexus::package-diagram-source
    outputs:
      diagram_source: package_diagram_source
  - kind: routine
    id: source-sequence-diagrams
    routine: gitnexus::sequence-diagram-source
    outputs:
      diagram_source: sequence_diagram_source
  - kind: technique
    id: create-architecture-summary
    technique: summarize-architecture
  - kind: technique
    id: analyze-strategic-findings
    technique:
      name: strategic-findings-analysis
      inputs:
        is_review_mode: "{is_review_mode}"
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: review-findings
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: "!="
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: strategic_findings_summary
          operator: "!="
          value: ""
    message: |-
      Strategic review complete.

      Findings:
      {strategic_findings_summary}

      Recommended action: {recommended_strategic_option}.
    options:
      - id: acceptable
        label: All acceptable
        description: Findings noted but no changes needed
        effect:
          setVariable:
            review_passed: true
            strategic_findings_disposition: acceptable
      - id: fix-findings
        label: Fix findings before proceeding
        description: Every finding is addressed before the change goes further
        effect:
          setVariable:
            strategic_findings_disposition: fix-all
      - id: selective-fixes
        label: Fix selected findings
        description: The reply names the findings to address, by priority; the report keeps the rest
        effect:
          setVariable:
            strategic_findings_disposition: fix-selected
      - id: defer-findings
        label: Defer findings
        description: Note findings for future but proceed now
        effect:
          setVariable:
            review_passed: true
            strategic_findings_disposition: deferred
      - id: more-review
        label: Need more review
        description: Additional areas need examination before any disposition is settled
        effect:
          setVariable:
            strategic_findings_disposition: re-review
  - kind: checkpoint
    id: findings-delivery
    condition:
      type: and
      conditions:
        - type: simple
          variable: is_review_mode
          operator: ==
          value: true
        - type: simple
          variable: strategic_findings_summary
          operator: "!="
          value: ""
    message: |-
      Strategic review findings. Every finding is the pull-request author's to act on.

      Findings:
      {strategic_findings_summary}

      Recommended action: {recommended_strategic_option}.
    options:
      - id: raise-all
        label: Raise all findings to the author
        description: The posted review carries every finding
        effect:
          setVariable:
            review_passed: true
            raised_findings_scope: all
      - id: raise-selected
        label: Raise selected findings
        description: The posted review carries the findings named in the reply; the report keeps the rest
        effect:
          setVariable:
            review_passed: true
            raised_findings_scope: selected
      - id: raise-none
        label: Raise none
        description: The report keeps every finding and the posted review carries none of them
        effect:
          setVariable:
            review_passed: true
            raised_findings_scope: none
exits:
  - id: review-mode
    when: is_review_mode == true
  - id: review-passed
    when: review_passed == true
  - id: needs-more-review
    when: strategic_findings_disposition == 're-review'
  - id: review-failed
    isDefault: true
outcome:
  - Changes validated as minimal and focused
  - Investigation artifacts and over-engineering removed
  - A record of scope and quality findings exists for reviewers to act on
  - Stakeholders have an architecture overview to understand the change
  - The change is traceable to its issue from the project's release notes, where the repo carries a root changes/ convention

corpus/work-package/activities/13-submit.text:
id: submit-for-review
version: 1.25.0
name: Submit for Review
description: Submit the work for review — PR review lifecycle normally; a verified private-remote push in stealth mode.
variables:
  reads:
    - awaiting_review
    - branch_name
    - changed_files
    - component_git_dir
    - head_sha
    - host_repo_path
    - is_review_mode
    - issue_number
    - planning_folder_path
    - pr_number
    - pr_url
    - prior_feedback_triage
    - problem_statement
    - project_type
    - provenance_log_path
    - push_remote
    - raised_findings_scope
    - rating_cap
    - requirements
    - squash_merge_supported
    - stealth_mode
    - summary_refine_requested
    - target_path
    - target_repo
    - ticket_disposition
  writes:
    - name: artifact_publish_ref
      type: string
      description: Engineering checkout's branch name.
      defaultValue: ""
    - name: attestation_option
      type: string
      description: What the human certified about the change at the DCO attestation gate.
      values:
        - certify
        - flag-legal
      defaultValue: certify
    - name: awaiting_review
      type: boolean
      description: True while submit-for-review is waiting for reviewer feedback.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: body_conforms
      type: boolean
      description: True once the rendered PR body satisfies every conformance criterion in the pr-description guide.
      defaultValue: false
    - name: body_findings
      type: array
      description: List of PR-body conformance violations.
      defaultValue: []
    - name: build_dependent_artifacts_pending
      type: boolean
